summary_text: TKO Q1 2026 earnings released May 6, 2026: revenue $1.597B, net income $249.8M, adjusted EBITDA $549.8M. WWE revenue $475.7M (+$84.2M YoY); UFC $401.2M (+$41.5M YoY). Board authorized additional $1B share repurchase. Full-year guidance reaffirmed. Upcoming: UFC Freedom 250 at White House this summer, On Location FIFA World Cup partnership.
